summary: Round 6 — ASAP Dispatch launch-blocker certification. Full backend test pack (/app/backend/tests/test_final_qa_r6.py) covering all 18 items in the review request: radius-ladder helper (5 bands + no-anchor default), dispatch_log outcomes (offline/offered/out_of_radius/busy/not_capable), driver /offers escalation E2E, driver-side ?radius_miles cap, admin /dispatch/active shape + 403 guard, admin /dispatch/log/{job_id} shape + 403 guard, customer /dispatch/{job_id} enrichment + anonymous 401/403 guard, persistent-queue behaviour (10-min-old unclaimed job still listed at 500 mi), cancel-removes-from-queue, transport ASAP claim flow (moves open→claimed with accepted_by), recovery ASAP with capability required + not_capable log, and multi-driver near-wins/far-only-after-escalation. Frontend UI smoke on /admin/dispatch confirms every data-testid required (admin-dispatch-monitor, dispatch-radius-ladder, dispatch-stat-waiting/claimed, dispatch-items, dispatch-search filter behaviour, dispatch-refresh, dispatch-item-<job_id>, dispatch-item-log-toggle-<job_id>, dispatch-log-<job_id>) and admin-dispatch-link on /admin dashboard. Regression: 36/36 of test_final_qa_r5.py + test_realtime_dispatch.py still pass. Total 23/23 new + 36/36 regression = 59/59 green.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 5294 lines — should be split into modules (auth/dispatch/jobs/admin) for maintainability. Non-blocking for this launch.
dispatch_log has no TTL index; on a busy market this collection will grow unbounded. Recommend adding a TTL of ~30 days on `ts` (best-effort, not required for launch).

customer_dispatch_state re-parses dispatch_ready_at three times per call (waiting_seconds, next_radius_expansion_at, _current_search_radius_miles). Micro-inefficient — parse once and reuse. Not a correctness issue.

admin_active_dispatches: per-job `dispatch_log.find(...).limit(500)` inside the loop is O(N_jobs * 500). Fine at current scale; consider a single `$facet` aggregation if the queue exceeds ~50 concurrent items.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of required data-testids present and functional

rca of the issue: Original bug: dispatch endpoint used a fixed 25-mile radius with no escalation. Fix implemented + certified: `_current_search_radius_miles` returns 10/20/40/75/500 mi based on age since dispatch_ready_at (server-authoritative, driver ?radius_miles=X only caps their own inbox). Persistent queue verified — a 10-minute-old unclaimed job still appears in /admin/dispatch/active items[queue_state=open] at 500 mi. dispatch_log collection captures every offer decision with driver_id, distance_miles, radius_used, outcome, reason, ts. Every test in the review request passed on first run — no fixes required.
